# BuilderBot

> BuilderBot is a free, open-source TypeScript and JavaScript framework for building automated chatbots and conversational agents across WhatsApp (Baileys, Meta Cloud API, Twilio, Venom, WPPConnect), Telegram, and other messaging channels with pluggable database adapters (Memory, JSON, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL).

Key facts for coding agents and LLMs:

- **Scaffold a new project:** `pnpm create builderbot@latest` or `npm create builderbot@latest` (requires Node.js >= 20 and Git).
- **Core package:** `@builderbot/bot` — exports `createBot`, `createFlow`, `createProvider`, `addKeyword`, `addAnswer`, `EVENTS`, `MemoryDB`.
- **Three core primitives:** **Flow** (conversation steps built with `addKeyword(...).addAnswer(...).addAction(...)`), **Provider** (channel adapter such as `@builderbot/provider-baileys`, `@builderbot/provider-meta`, `@builderbot/provider-twilio`), and **Database** (`@builderbot/database-memory`, `@builderbot/database-json`, `@builderbot/database-mongo`, `@builderbot/database-mysql`, `@builderbot/database-postgres`).
- **Markdown endpoints:** Every documentation page has a clean Markdown counterpart at `<url>.md` (for example, `https://www.builderbot.app/en/quickstart.md`).
- **Context bundles:** Curated core context at [https://www.builderbot.app/llms-ctx.txt](https://www.builderbot.app/llms-ctx.txt) and complete documentation corpus at [https://www.builderbot.app/llms-full.txt](https://www.builderbot.app/llms-full.txt).
- **Localized indexes:** [English (https://www.builderbot.app/en/llms.txt)](https://www.builderbot.app/en/llms.txt) · [Español (https://www.builderbot.app/es/llms.txt)](https://www.builderbot.app/es/llms.txt) · [Português (https://www.builderbot.app/pt/llms.txt)](https://www.builderbot.app/pt/llms.txt).

- [Playground](https://www.builderbot.app/en/playground.md): Write BuilderBot flows with addKeyword, addAnswer and addAction and chat with them in the browser, powered by the real @builderbot/bot core.

## Basics

- [Add keyword](https://www.builderbot.app/en/add-functions.md): addKeyword is the starting point of a conversation flow, just need to pass an array of keywords, when someone text those keywords in the chatbot, the function will trigger the predefined dialog you have set up.
- [Context](https://www.builderbot.app/en/context.md): The "context" object is a key component within the framework that provides developers with access to essential information about the ongoing interaction between the user and the bot. This information includes default...
- [Methods](https://www.builderbot.app/en/methods.md): Inside each addAction or addAnswer we can execute logic and we can make use of some methods that will facilitate the development.
- [Events](https://www.builderbot.app/en/events.md): Sometimes users send messages such as an image, a video or special location messages, among others, to receive and start a conversation when a message of this type arrives we can use the events.
- [Errors](https://www.builderbot.app/en/errors.md): This error occurs when you're using handleCtx, which is a method responsible for handling and checking if the session instantiation is correct. Possible causes of this error are:

## Deploy

- [Deploying](https://www.builderbot.app/en/deploy.md): Congratulations the time has come to take your project to production and for your convenience there are several ways to achieve this from quite tenic options to other easier strategies.
- [Railway](https://www.builderbot.app/en/deploy/railway.md): Railway provides infrastructure primitives with sane defaults to manage secrets, builds, and deploys. So you can start quickly and focus on your product.
- [Deploy](https://www.builderbot.app/en/deploy/docker.md): In this guide, we will discuss how to create a Dockerfile and how to deploy your bot.
- [VPS (Virtual Private Server)](https://www.builderbot.app/en/deploy/vps.md): Prioritize initiating a connection to your server using SSH or via your chosen cloud provider's preferred method. This initial step is essential to start following this entire tutorial.
- [Deploying Your Chatbot with Meta API](https://www.builderbot.app/en/deploy/meta.md): This guide is designed for those who have already followed the official documentation at Meta Provider. It assumes that developer accounts have been created and business and app verification has been completed.
